# #924 — test: six tracing tests fail order-dependently in the Mac root checkout, pass in a lane clone on the same tree

State: OPEN
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-08-27T15:05:03Z
Updated: 2026-08-27T15:05:03Z

---

Filed by Claude (head, 2026-08-27, claudex fable) while pushing #923.

## What

`bun run test:isolated` fails six tests when run from the Mac checkout `/Volumes/ThunderBolt/Development/open-brain` and passes when the same tree runs from a lane clone.

- root checkout at `8171261f` (main `213974e9` plus three doc/shell files): `4001 pass, 6 fail` on two consecutive runs (pre-push hook, then by hand)
- lane clone `/Volumes/ThunderBolt/_tmp/open-brain/_worktrees/lane-1` at `213974e9`: `4007 pass, 0 fail`
- the six alone in the root checkout (`bun run test:isolated server/observability`): `78 pass, 0 fail`

Failing tests, all order-dependent (pass alone, fail in the full run):

- `server/observability/langfuse-tracing.test.ts` — `readMcpTracingConfig > the incomplete-flag warn is emitted, readable, and carries no key value` (`expect(received).toBeDefined()`)
- `createTracingRuntime — the composition root's seam > the bounded drain warns content-free on timeout`
- `outage alerts fire on state change only` × 4 (`toHaveLength`)

## What was ruled out

- `.env` keys: identical between the two checkouts (`diff` of the key sets is empty)
- the diff under test: docs and one shell script; the failures are in files the branch does not touch

## Not yet known

What differs between the two checkouts for these tests. Candidates not checked: `node_modules` contents (root has a nested `node_modules/node_modules` and no `oxlint`), ignored files under `.claude/`, and which earlier test file leaves the shared sink or config state behind.

## Why it matters

The pre-push hook refuses a push from the root checkout, so a head pushing its own paperwork branch has to route through a lane clone. The rule already says lanes work in clones; this is the head's checkout disagreeing with them on the same tree.
